quiz.title: Python for Data Engineering
quiz.description: Core Python and Pandas skills used to build data pipelines: data structures, functions, file I/O, virtual environments, and DataFrame manipulation.

questions.question_text: Which built-in Python data structure stores key-value pairs?
Which Python library is most commonly used for tabular data manipulation in data engineering?
What does the Pandas method 'read_csv()' do?
questions.option_a: Loads data from a CSV file into a DataFrame
questions.option_b: Saves a DataFrame to a CSV file
questions.correct_answer: Loads data from a CSV file into a DataFrame

questions.question_text: In Pandas, which method removes rows containing missing values?
What is the purpose of a Python virtual environment?
questions.option_a: To isolate project dependencies from the global Python installation
questions.option_b: To speed up Python code execution
questions.option_c: To compile Python into machine code
questions.correct_answer: To isolate project dependencies from the global Python installation

questions.question_text: Which command creates a new virtual environment named 'venv'?

questions.option_a: Installs all packages listed in the requirements file
questions.correct_answer: Installs all packages listed in the requirements file

questions.question_text: In Pandas, which method combines two DataFrames based on a shared column, similar to a SQL join?
What does a Pandas 'groupby()' operation typically precede?
questions.option_a: An aggregation function such as sum() or mean()
questions.correct_answer: An aggregation function such as sum() or mean()

questions.question_text: Which Python construct is best suited for repeating an action for each item in a list?
What is the main advantage of using a Jupyter notebook for data engineering work?
questions.option_a: It lets you run code in cells and see output interactively, useful for exploring and testing pipeline steps
questions.option_b: It automatically deploys code to production
questions.option_c: It replaces the need for version control
questions.correct_answer: It lets you run code in cells and see output interactively, useful for exploring and testing pipeline steps

questions.question_text: Which Python keyword is used to handle exceptions so a pipeline doesn't crash on bad data?
What does Pandas' 'to_json()' method do on a DataFrame?
questions.option_a: Converts the DataFrame into JSON format
questions.correct_answer: Converts the DataFrame into JSON format
